meta.requirement: Explore Dawn Winery (40%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Load Stone
start.text:
''A portable forge leans against Dawn Winery's outer wall. Harness frames hang like stubborn laundry.''

''The smith stops mid-strike. Soot and sweat stripe his forearms.''

Corvin: Traveler. Good. I need someone who does not scare easy.

What_s_wrong_.text:
Corvin: Under this manor sits a Load Stone. Geo crystal. Old temper stock.

Corvin: Slice a shaving, rivet it into a frame, and the pack holds twenty kilograms more without folding.

choices.label: So why is it still down there?
And you can't just buy plates?

So_why_is_it_still_down_there_.text:
Corvin: Because three Geo seals locked it after a cellar collapse. One worker dead. House called it sealed and holy and done.

Corvin: ''tongs jab the dirt'' I call it wasted steel.

You_want_it_opened.text:
Corvin: Help me open it and the first shaving becomes your load plates. Permanent. On your pack.

Corvin: That is the pay. Fair?

choices.label: Fair. How do we get in?

Fair__How_do_we_get_in_.text:
Corvin: Two doors. Adelinde holds proper cellar leave. Clean. Slow. Legal.

Corvin: Reed knows a drainage cut from the old accident. Fast. Dirty. He still drinks like he owes the stone blood.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Choose how to open the Load Stone under Dawn Winery

I_ll_ask_Adelinde.text: Corvin: Good. Tell her I am not stripping the house for scrap. Tell her you will obey wards.

Where_is_she_.text: Corvin: Manor hall. I will keep the forge hot.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Speak with Adelinde at Dawn Winery about cellar access

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Speak with Adelinde

I_ll_find_Reed.text: Corvin: ''grimace'' Fine. Reed is the man who lived. He knows the cut better than anyone still breathing.

Lived_through_what_.text:
Corvin: The collapse. His partner did not crawl out. Reed did, through the drainage.

Corvin: He will help you. He will also hate himself for knowing how.

I_ll_find_him.text: Corvin: Wolvendom runoff mouth. Look for someone pretending wolves are the problem.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Meet Reed at the drainage mouth in Wolvendom

continues.label: Go to Wolvendom (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Meet Reed at the Drainage Mouth

Meet_Reed_at_the_Drainage_Mouth.text:
''A wet stone pipe mouths the Wolvendom edge. A wiry man kicks mud and watches trees too hard.''

Reed: Corvin's runner. Good. Paper doors make me itch.

choices.label: You know a cut to the vault

You_know_a_cut_to_the_vault.text:
Reed: I know it because I ran it while someone called my name behind me.

Reed: ''flat'' His name was Orrin. Seal work. I left him. The cut got me out. The house locked the stone so nobody else would "help" like I did.

choices.label: And now you want back in

And_now_you_want_back_in.text:
Reed: Hilichurls nested in the first bend. Clear them.

Reed: Then bring me grit and an offering. Same recipe the house would use, just uglier.

What_recipe_.text:
Reed: Twenty Crystal Chunk. Geo grit.

Reed: Sixty Silver Raven Insignia, or sixty Black Bronze Horn. Greed or brute force. The seals hate both. We feed them a little so they soften on our schedule.

Then_what_.text:
Reed: I mix a primer. You plant it at Windrise under the oak. Old Geo line thinks someone still worships upstream.

Reed: Distracts the seals long enough for a chorus later. Silly. Works. When it worked for cowards, anyway.

Hilichurls_first.text: Reed: I stay at the mouth. If you die in there, I get to say I warned you.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Clear the Hilichurls from the drainage cut in Wolvendom

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Clear the Drainage Cut. Defeat 2 [[Hilichurl]]s and 1 [[Hilichurl Berserker]]

Why_help_Corvin_.text:
Reed: Because Corvin will actually forge something useful. And because if those seals open right, maybe Orrin stops shouting in my sleep.

Reed: Or he doesn't. Either way, we do this careful.

Clear_the_Drainage_Cut.text:
''The cut goes quiet except for drip water. Reed peeks in and nods once.''

Reed: Path's clear.

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Reed

Talk_to_Reed.text:
''The cut goes quiet except for drip water. Reed peeks in and nods once.''

Reed: Path's clear.

What_do_you_need_.text:
Reed: Twenty Crystal Chunk. Plus sixty raven marks or sixty bronze horns.

Reed: Come back heavy.

I_can_t_carry_that_much.text:
Reed: Then do not. Four trips. Five crystal, fifteen of one offering. Same paste. Just staggered.

Reed: Pick greed or horns. Then walk.

Still_gathering.text: Reed: I am not going anywhere pretty.

Reed: Windrise. West root hollow. Plant it. Leave.

Reed: After you plant it, three hours soak. Then Windrise again for three hours of smoke. Two waits. Both matter.

Speak_with_Adelinde.text:
''Adelinde meets you with a ledger and a look that already counted your boots.''

Adelinde: Corvin's traveler. He warned me in three sentences.

choices.label: We need the Load Stone opened

We_need_the_Load_Stone_opened.text:
Adelinde: Then we open it as the house. Not as thieves in our own cellar.

Adelinde: The seals were set so greed and panic could not dig again. I will not break them with either.

choices.label: What do you need from me?

What_s_the_proper_way_.text:
Adelinde: First, clear scavengers off the east service path. They have been sniffing the sealed cellar like dogs at a locked pantry.

Adelinde: Then I give you a Guild request. Stamp in Mondstadt. After that, Springvale salts.

I_ll_clear_the_path.text: Adelinde: East service path. When it is quiet, come back.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Drive Treasure Hoarders off the service path at Dawn Winery

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Clear the Service Path. Defeat 1 [[Treasure Hoarder Crusher]] and 1 [[Treasure Hoarder Marksman]]

why_salts.text:
Adelinde: Crystal Chunk is the grit. The seals drink Geo.

Adelinde: Sixty Silver Raven Insignia, or sixty Black Bronze Horn. Stolen greed, or brute force. The ward was built to swallow both. We feed it a measured dose so it softens instead of snaps.

Clear_the_Service_Path.text:
''The last Treasure Hoarder drops. Wine air returns to the path.''

''Adelinde is already waiting with a waxed packet.''

Adelinde: Acceptable.

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Adelinde

Talk_to_Adelinde.text:
''The last Treasure Hoarder drops. Wine air returns to the path.''

''Adelinde is already waiting with a waxed packet.''

Adelinde: Acceptable.

Is_that_the_Guild_request_.text:
Adelinde: Sealed. Guild desk in Mondstadt. Ask for a stamp under Adelinde of Dawn Winery.

Adelinde: Do not open it. Do not "improve" my wording.

dialogues.speaker: 📦 Obtained
dialogues.text: 1x [img:../Textures/Items/Sealed Scroll_icon.png]'''[[Sealed Scroll]]'''

Mondstadt__Got_it_.text: Adelinde: Go. Look competent. It helps.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver Adelinde's sealed request to the Adventurers' Guild in Mondstadt

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver Adelinde's Request

And_after_the_stamp_.text:
Adelinde: Springvale well. Twenty Crystal Chunk, plus sixty raven marks or sixty bronze horns.

Adelinde: Mix. Wait. Soften. Cure. Then the vault.

Remind_me_why_those_offerings_.text: Adelinde: Because the seals were written against theft and blunt force. We apologize to them in their own language. Measured. Not panicked.

Deliver_Adelinde_s_Request.text:
''The Guild desk smells of wet cloaks and ink.''

Clerk: Dawn Winery cellar leave?

Stamp_for_Adelinde__please.text:
Clerk: ''stamp'' Outer ward softening authorized.

Clerk: Try not to die under somebody else's wine.

dialogues.speaker: 📦 Gave
dialogues.text: 1x [img:../Textures/Items/Sealed Scroll_icon.png]'''[[Sealed Scroll]]'''

Springvale_next_.text: ''Adelinde's list is simple now: twenty Crystal Chunk, and either sixty Silver Raven Insignia or sixty Black Bronze Horn, at the Springvale well.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring ward salt materials to Springvale in four trips

continues.label: Go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Talk at the Springvale Well

Talk_at_the_Springvale_Well.text: ''Chalk circles ring an old basin by the Springvale well. A strip of paper names the grit and the two allowed offerings. Twenty crystal. Sixty of one.''

choices.label: That's more than my pack holds

Why_either_of_those_.text: ''Adelinde's note, smaller hand:'' Crystal feeds Geo. Raven marks are greed the ward already knows. Bronze horns are force it already fears. Either completes the salt. Not both. Not less.

Still_gatheringajaja.text: ''The chalk waits. The Load Stone will not forever.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring ward salt materials to Springvale in four trips

I_can_t_carry_this_much_.text:
''Adelinde's note, cramped in the margin:'' You will not carry that in one trip. Nobody does.

''Four trips. Five Crystal Chunk and fifteen of one offering each time. Mix as you go. Same salt. Just staggered.''

''Choose raven greed or bronze force. Then start walking.''

Check_the_Outer_Ward_with_Adelinde.text:
''Adelinde checks a pocket watch.''

Adelinde: Outer ward is soft enough.

Vault_now_.text:
Adelinde: Not yet. Take the jar back to Springvale. Three more hours to cure.

Adelinde: Soft is not safe. Cured is safe.

I_ll_wait_it_out_.text: Adelinde: Do not rush curing. That is how cellars eat people.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to the Springvale well in 3 hours. The ward salts must finish curing

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, and after that go to Springvale (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Check the Curing Salts

Check_the_Curing_Salts.text: ''At the well the grit has gone pale to amber. Ready.''

To_the_vault.text: ''Dawn Winery's cellar stairs breathe cold. Geo light pulses past wreckage and old chalk.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Geo guardians at the Load Stone vault under Dawn Winery

continues.label: Go to Dawn Winery (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Enter the Load Stone Vault. Defeat 2 [[Geo Slime]]s and 1 [[Geo Samachurl]]

Anything_else_first_.text: ''Adelinde's last scrap:'' Guardians first. Then three Geo seals. Then Corvin takes one shaving. Only one.

Enter_the_Load_Stone_Vault.text:
''The Geo guardians crack and go quiet. Three seal pillars wake around the Load Stone.''

Corvin: ''from the stair'' Good.

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Talk to Corvin

Talk_to_Corvin.text:
''The Geo guardians crack and go quiet. Three seal pillars wake around the Load Stone.''

Corvin: ''from the stair'' Good.

Now_the_seals_.text: Corvin: Three seals. Three Geo travelers. Same breath. I can hold one. You find two more who are not cowards.

We_ll_wake_them_together.text: Corvin: When they open, one shaving. Only one. Greed gets people sealed in dirt.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Resonate the three Geo seals at the Load Stone vault with two other travelers

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Resonate the Geo Seals

why_three.text: Corvin: Because panic digging killed Orrin. The lock demands company so nobody opens this alone again.

I_ll_gather_travelers.text: Corvin: One shaving. Only one. Reed already paid the price of taking more than the stone allowed.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Resonate the three Geo seals at the Load Stone vault with two other travelers

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Resonate the Geo Seals

triple_geo_seals.title: 🪨 Triple Geo Seals
triple_geo_seals.text:
''Three seals. Three Geo marks. They will only wake if three travelers answer together.''

Need 3 players with [img:../Textures/Elements/Element_Geo.webp]Geo element in Dawn Winery (Mondstadt)

Each player must imbue each seals at the same time (within a ~3-second window of each other). Complete within 1 minute

continues.label: Do /rpg again after successfully imbued Geo to the seals, and then click on Talk to Corvin

Talk_to_Corvin_.text:
''Three Geo answers meet. The Load Stone sheds a clean plane of crystal.''

Corvin: ''wrapping it'' Upstairs. Forge. Now.

Forge_the_plates.text: Corvin: Outer wall. Same crooked forge.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to Corvin at Dawn Winery for the load plates

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Collect Your Load Plates

Collect_Your_Load_Plates.text:
''Heat drinks the shaving. Corvin rivets plates into your frame.''

Corvin: Twenty kilograms more. Permanent.

____The_Load_Stone__Opened_by_Leave.text:
Adelinde: ''from the path, dry'' I approved competence. Do not waste either.

Corvin: ''almost smiling'' Go carry something heavy on purpose.

Place_the_Primed_Charge.text: ''The Windrise oak holds the sky open. West root hollow. Old Geo dust answers slight pressure.''

Not_yet.text: ''The hollow waits. Reed's timer does not.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Place Reed's primed charge under the oak at Windrise

Place_Reed_s_primed_charge_.text: ''The primer sinks and stops humming, which somehow feels louder.''

Back_to_Reed.text: ''Somewhere under Mondstadt stone, a Geo line leans the wrong useful way. Three hours.''

dialogues.text: Return to Reed in Wolvendom in 3 hours. The charge must soak

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, and after that go to Wolvendom (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Check the Charge Soak with Reed

Vault_.text:
Reed: Windrise again. Smoke clears in three hours. After that the vault locks will take a chorus.

Reed: ''quieter'' If you get a chance, tell the stone I am sorry. Or don't. I still will be.

I_ll_wait_out_the_smoke_.text: Reed: When the oak air stops tasting like hot metal, go to the winery cellar. Corvin will be twitching.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to the oak at Windrise in 3 hours. The smoke must clear

continues.label: Wait for 3 hours, and after that go to Windrise (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Check the Primer Site

Check_the_Primer_Site.text: ''The hollow is clean of smoke. Only oak and faint warmth remain.''
